ranked_untried_hypotheses.title: Seamless 10 m USGS 3DEP Asymmetric Scarp Continuation + Census TIGER Road-Cut & GeoDAWN Survey-Seam Deconfounding
layers_used: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (~10 m) seamless DEM (ScienceBase 4f70aa9fe4b058caae3f8de5, 100.0% footprint coverage)
U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line 2024 Roads across 32 CA/NV counties (tiger_road_distance_m.tif)
USGS GeoDAWN Four Acquisition Blocks (Winnemucca, Fallon, Hawthorne, Tonopah; DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ)
Competition training_features.tif + 1 m 3DEP LiDAR + GDR 1391 hydrothermal stack (101 KPL-36 features)
ranked_untried_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Computes 16 seamless 10 m scarp & piedmont descriptors (30 m one-sided normal-fault throw asymmetry dem10_onesided3, 20 m-vs-200 m scarp sharpness ratio, 8-azimuth 3.1 km directional line-integral persistence of dem10_onesided3, and G8-G2 range-front piedmont slope inflection) across 100% of the 5,167,373-pixel footprint, closing the 24.63% (1,272,894 px) 1 m LiDAR void where KPL-36 fell back to coarse 100 m topography. Simultaneously deconfounds anthropogenic road/railroad/bunker embankment cuts via exp(-d_road/120 m)*dem10_hgm20_max and removes inter-block airborne survey tie-line steps via within-block MAD normalization of magnetic horizontal gradient and potassium radiometrics plus seam distance.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.why_missed_by_catalogue: USGS Qfaults/existing_faults.tif systematically under-maps degraded 1-4 m Quaternary fault scarps inside the 24.63% NE/central 1 m LiDAR gap and thin-alluvium range-front piedmont hinges, while pixelwise LiDAR detectors waste precision budget on highway cuts and Hawthorne Army Depot berms in the SW Walker Lane.
named_non_fault_mimics: I-80 / US-95 / US-395 / US-50 highway road-cuts, railroad grades, and Hawthorne Army Depot earthen bunker berms
Inter-survey tie-line & spectrometer calibration seams between Winnemucca, Fallon, Hawthorne, and Tonopah GeoDAWN blocks
ranked_untried_hypotheses.difference_from_existing_implementations: No prior GEMSDOE36 lane (HVG-36, GVSC-36, CSDL-36, KPL-36, BDC-36) ingested seamless 10 m 3DEP DEM channels, Census TIGER road distance, or GeoDAWN 4-block seam normalization.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (~35 s feature build, 21 float32 columns)

ranked_untried_hypotheses.title: Two-Stage Multi-Azimuth Corridor U-GBDT Stacker + Local-vs-District (800 m vs 2.4 km) Piedmont Halo Sharpening
layers_used: Out-of-subquadrant Stage-1 calibrated probability field P1 from H-S2D-1
GeoDAWN basement gravity/magnetic worm & GDR 1391 hydrothermal upflow corroboration channels
ranked_untried_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Constructs 14 spatial structural-corridor features on strictly out-of-fold Stage-1 probabilities: domain-normalized multi-scale Gaussian context (150 m, 400 m, 800 m, 1.6 km), ridge-vs-apron sharpness (G_1.5 - G_8), 8-azimuth directional line integrals at 900 m and 1.7 km (along-strike persistence minus orthogonal cross-strike width), 2D Hessian ridge crest eigenvalue max(0, -lambda_min), and geometric corroboration sqrt(G_2(P1) * subsurface_support). Fits a regularized Stage-2 Corridor HGB (0.28 * P1 + 0.72 * P2) followed by province-preserving 800 m halo sharpening.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.why_missed_by_catalogue: Blind geothermal transfer zones and en-echelon relay ramps bridge 0.5-2 km alluvial gaps where pixelwise surface expression drops below single-cell threshold, while true fault corridors maintain narrow (<300 m) linear continuity backed by basement density/magnetic gradients.
named_non_fault_mimics: 1-2 km wide range-front alluvial-fan slope aprons (high isotropic G_8 halo, low ridge sharpness, causing double-ring FP dots outboard of range fronts)
Equidimensional volcanic/intrusive stocks, playettes, and isolated thermal spring travertine mounds (low along-vs-cross strike contrast)
ranked_untried_hypotheses.difference_from_existing_implementations: All prior GEMSDOE36 lanes were strictly single-stage pixelwise tree models; none learned a second-stage spatial probability-topology U-GBDT or applied province-preserving halo subtraction prior to 300 m CELF.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (~5 min inner sub-quadrant OOF + Stage-2 training across 4 folds)

ranked_untried_hypotheses.title: Dual-Population Quaternary + Fold-Safe Pre-2022 Bedrock Conduit Auxiliary Representation (Zero SGMC Input Features)
layers_used: USGS SGMC State Geologic Map Compilation pre-2022 bedrock faults (DOI 10.3133/ds1052, derived_sgmc_faults_100m_u8.tif) used STRICTLY inside fold['train'] & (d_vis >= 3 px) as auxiliary training supervision (0 SGMC input features)
122-feature label-free S2D Stage-1 stack + 14 Stage-2 corridor descriptors
ranked_untried_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Trains an out-of-fold Dual-Population Stage-1 expert inside each training fold (Quaternary labels weight 1.0 + off-catalogue pre-2022 bedrock fault targets weight 0.25 on S2D_BLIND sensor features, zero SGMC features at any stage) and passes 4 OOF dual-population corridor descriptors (dual_prob, dual_g4, dual_line13_max, sqrt(G_2(P1)*G_2(P_dual))) into Stage-2 calibrated strictly to competition Bayes odds.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.why_missed_by_catalogue: Quaternary scarp compilations suffer survivorship bias against range-front bedrock contact faults, thin-veneered horst blocks, and accommodation zones where unconsolidated Holocene fan cover is absent or eroded.
named_non_fault_mimics: Inactive sealed pre-Cenozoic thrust faults in range interiors (downweighted in Stage-2 because Stage-2 calibrates strictly against active competition fault targets and requires scarp/hydrothermal/gravity corridor agreement)
ranked_untried_hypotheses.difference_from_existing_implementations: Prior GEMSDOE36 lanes supervised exclusively on single-population Quaternary labels; unlike naive label-mixing, S2D-36 isolates bedrock supervision in an OOF auxiliary expert calibrated in Stage-2 to prevent precision loss on inactive thrusts.

ranked_untried_hypotheses.title: Multi-Temporal Sentinel-1 InSAR Phase-Gradient / Coherence-Drop Lineaments + Raw 1-D GeoDAWN Flight-Line Wavelet Singularity Picking
layers_used: Copernicus Sentinel-1A/B ascending/descending interferometric coherence & LOS velocity gradients (ASF Vertex)
USGS ScienceBase 657e1d85d34e23d3533209f7 raw 1-D flight-line aeromagnetic profiles (pre-gridding)
ranked_untried_hypotheses.physical_signature_and_transform: Sharp cross-fault step in stacked InSAR LOS phase gradient + seasonal coherence decorrelation boundary across blind playettes, paired with 1-D continuous wavelet modulus maxima along raw 200 m-spaced east-west flight lines prior to minimum-curvature gridding.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.why_missed_by_catalogue: Aseismic creep, geothermal reservoir pore-pressure breathing (e.g., Bradys, San Emidio, Dixie Valley), and clay-gouge groundwater barriers create sharp InSAR phase steps across zero-relief playas with zero topographic scarp.
named_non_fault_mimics: Agricultural pivot-irrigation subsidence bowls and playa evaporite moisture rings
ranked_untried_hypotheses.difference_from_existing_implementations: Untried across all GEMSDOE focus repos.
ranked_untried_hypotheses.implementation_cost: High / Deferred — direct outbound egress to asf.alaska.edu and sciencebase.gov is blocked by sandbox allowlist and multi-GB SLC processing exceeds 2-CPU / 3.8 GiB RAM / 3-experiment budget.

excluded_on_audit.reason: Forensic audit of dem1m_tile_audit.json showed its 8 EarthMRI tiles (1.39% of footprint) were ranked using tips_in_tile from existing_faults.tif (== labels.tif). Excluded from S2D-36 features to preserve 100% strict zero-catalogue, zero-selection-bias purity across held-out quadrants.

frozen_gates.fail_closed_policy: Automatic verdict is 'promote' ONLY if G1 AND G2 AND G3a AND G3b AND G3c AND G4 all pass. Under the unamended literal all-198-entry rule (G3c), reg-052 (5x5 lattice, covering radius sqrt(8)=2.83<=3.0 px on 99.87% of footprint) forces G3c=False for any interior geological submission, so automatic release verdict MUST fail closed ('negative', DO NOT SUBMIT without human selector sign-off per Rule 6).
